jobs.title: Physics Tutor in Tulsa
jobs.description:
BuffTutor is a network of experienced and passionate tutors who provide academic assistance to college & high school students. We are always hiring dedicated tutors; if you love teaching, join us!
RESPONSIBILITIES:

•
Provide 1-on-1 in-person tutoring to students attending universities or high schools in Tulsa such as University of Tulsa.

•
Provide online tutoring to students located throughout the country (if desired).

•
Assist students with Physics topics

• Classical mechanics: Kinematics, dynamics, forces, momentum, energy
,• Thermodynamics: Heat, temperature, ideal gases, laws of thermodynamics
,• Electricity and magnetism: Charges, fields, potential, circuits, induction
,• Waves and optics: Wave characteristics, sound, geometric/physical optics
,• Relativity and modern physics: Time dilation, length contraction, quantum basics
,• Nuclear physics: Radioactivity, fission, fusion, and atomic structures

BENEFITS:
• Set your own rate.
• In-person & online tutoring available; meet wherever works for you.
• Set your own schedule; meet whenever works for you.
• Work with as many (or as few) students as you would like to.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Have at least a 3.0 or better major GPA (out of 4.0).
• Have earned a B or better in the courses you wish to tutor.
• Have at least one year (or two semesters) of experience as a tutor, teacher, teaching/learning assistant or instructor.
• Have excellent communication skills and you must be fluent in the language that you teach in. Foreign Language tutors must be fluent in the Foreign Language they wish to tutor.

ABOUT BUFFTUTOR:
BuffTutor is dedicated to connecting students with intelligent and experienced tutors. We primarily focus on university level tutoring, but also work with high school and middle school students. More than just another tutor list, we prioritize the academic needs of our students while also treating our tutors with dignity and respect:
• We have some of the strictest eligibility criteria and challenging proficiency exams. Only the best can join our network!
• Tutors can set their own schedule. Our motto is quality is more important than quantity. Take on one student but be the best tutor for that student!
• Tutors can set their own rate. Earn what you are worth!
• We review student evaluations to help us keep the best tutor in our network.
BuffTutor was founded in 2009 and since then we have helped thousands of students and parents connect with affordable and passionate educators!
Please note that tutors are independent contractors, not employees. All applicants must already have work permissions; applicants who are students must be able to work an off-campus position. We do not sponsor individuals and we cannot work with F-1 or J-1 international students

jobs.title: Metrology Specialist | CMM Programming, GD&T & Precision Inspection
jobs.description:
25th September, 2026

Own the CMM programs and inspection plans behind high-volume die-cast parts, on-site in Sallisaw, OK.
Metrology Specialist | CMM Programming, GD&T & Precision Inspection

Some metrology roles mean running someone else's program on repeat. This one puts you in charge of the measurement side. You'd write and maintain the CMM programs, inspection plans and procedures that decide whether complex die-cast components meet their dimensional, geometric and tolerance requirements.

You would be the person the Quality team relies on when a dimension is in question. Your analysis against engineering drawings, GD&T and customer specifications directly shapes defect reduction and process optimization in a high-volume production environment.

If you like precision work but also want to be close to the process, this role offers both. Your time is split between a climate-controlled quality lab and the active plant floor.
Why This Opportunity Is Different

This role goes beyond inspection into real influence on the process. You would partner directly with Quality, Engineering and Production to troubleshoot dimensional anomalies and support root-cause investigations. You would also work with tooling and process engineers on die-casting process improvements and measurement efficiency.

The breadth of exposure is strong too: CMM programming across multiple platforms, First Article Inspections, PPAP submissions, quality system audits, and calibration with traceability to national standards, all within ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 frameworks. For a metrology professional who wants to grow skills that are recognized across manufacturing, this is a strong platform.
What You'll Be Doing
• Verify that die-cast components conform to dimensional, geometric and tolerance requirements using CMM, calipers, micrometers, height gauges and optical measurement systems
• Program and operate CMMs such as Zeiss, Mitutoyo and Hexagon to measure complex geometries and critical dimensions
• Create, maintain and execute measurement programs, inspection plans and standard procedures
• Analyze measurement data to confirm full compliance with engineering drawings, GD&T standards and customer specifications
• Partner with Quality, Engineering and Production to resolve dimensional anomalies and support root-cause investigations
• Support First Article Inspections, PPAP submissions and quality system audits
• Calibrate and maintain metrology tools so measurements stay traceable to national standards
• Keep accurate inspection records in line with ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 requirements
• Work with tooling and process engineers to improve die-casting processes and measurement efficiency
What We're Looking For
• High School Diploma or GED required
• 3+ years of quality inspection or metrology experience in a manufacturing environment
• Proven proficiency operating and programming CMM software platforms
• Strong expertise in GD&T
• Hands-on mastery of precision measuring instruments and blueprint interpretation
• Familiarity with ISO 9001 or IATF 16949 quality management frameworks
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and metrology or data management software
• Associate Degree or technical certification in Metrology, Engineering Technology or a related field is preferred
• Die-casting process and tooling experience, SPC and data analysis tools, and practical QMS knowledge are strong assets
• A detail-oriented, collaborative professional who can explain measurement findings clearly to engineering and production teams
Compensation & Work Model
• Compensation is competitive and will be discussed during the screening process.
• Full-time, on-site.
Location & Travel
• On-site in Sallisaw, Oklahoma
• Work is split between a climate-controlled quality laboratory and an active manufacturing plant floor
• Requires standing for extended periods and working around noise, heat and active machinery
• Must be able to occasionally lift up to 25 lbs
About TAPP Workforce Solutions

jobs.title: Instrumentation and Electrical Technician Intern (Tulsa or Oklahoma City, OK)
jobs.description:
About the position

Join ONEOK as an Instrumentation and Electrical Technician Intern this summer and become part of a team that upholds our core values of ethics, safety and environmental, excellence, diversity and inclusion, innovation, and service. This role will be based out of Tulsa or Oklahoma City, OK. This is an entry-level intern position focused on providing hands-on support and technical expertise to our Instrumentation and Electrical teams. As an I&E intern, you will assist with the maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of instrumentation and electrical systems critical to our operations. This opportunity will provide you with valuable experience in the midstream energy industry, working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

Responsibilities
• Assist with the installation, operation, and maintenance of instrumentation such as transmitters, transducers, fire and gas detectors, gas analyzers, and flow computers.
• Maintain ESD and safety interlock systems (SIS) with scheduled testing.
• Support the maintenance and operation of analytical equipment, SCADA systems, remote terminal units, DCS, and PLC systems.
• Maintain and test operation technology (OT) networks and network equipment.
• Perform preventative maintenance and analytical testing on compressors, engines, drivers, and auxiliary equipment.
• Maintain low and medium voltage electrical power circuits, switchgear, and power distribution systems.
• Maintain and prepare reports and records, including maintenance and repair logs, safety and environmental reports, mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, pressure readings, material orders, and loop sheets.
• Assist in a wide range of responsibilities inclusive of job shadowing, preparing reports, analyzing data, learning about various operational, technical, and/or business-related compliance, regulatory, and/or technical components.
• Assist with development of presentations, trainings, knowledge sharing, and/or other administrative responsibilities.
• Responsibilities may include Department of Transportation (DOT) covered functions, including operations, maintenance, or emergency response on a pipeline. Job duties also require the employee to be alert and respond immediately to dangerous or hazardous conditions, and where impaired performance, or failure to follow safety precautions, could result in serious injury or property damage.

Requirements
• High school diploma required and must be at least 18 years old.
• Currently enrolled in a relevant technical or related program preferred.
• Strong commitment to safety and environmental responsibility.
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Willingness to work outdoors in various weather conditions.
• Ability to: take initiative, demonstrate a positive attitude with an eagerness to learn, and be adaptable.
• Ability to: apply basic arithmetic: addition, subtraction, multiplication and division and/or advanced math, algebra, and/or statistical methods.
• Ability to: communicate, exchange written and verbal information and/or instructions.
• Ability to: contribute critical thinking skills, work well in teams, have a strong work ethic, attention to detail, and strong verbal and written communication skills.

Nice-to-haves
• Basic understanding of instrumentation and electrical principles is a plus.
• The candidate should be currently pursuing a certificate or degree relevant to the internship field.

Benefits
• ONEOK is committed to making our workplace accessible to individuals with disabilities and will provide reasonable accommodations, upon request, for individuals to participate in the application and hiring process.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

OWL Services is the premier sales, installation, program management and service provider to retail, commercial, fleet, aviation and marine, and emergency power generation companies across the U.S.

With 33 offices and distribution centers and more than 1,400 field service professionals, OWL delivers on a service platform that includes construction, compliance and testing, maintenance and repair, modernization and re-imaging, and EV charging solutions to keep businesses and people moving 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.

OWL Servicesâ companies have received numerous awards over the years for exemplary customer service. Most recently it was the recipient of EVgoâs Deployment Excellence Award in its first-ever class of awardees in the National EV Charging Recognition Program.

Come join us! For more information visit OWLServices.com and follow us on LinkedIn .

The Role:

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data Warehouse & BI team and help us expand the reach, depth, and operational impact of our modern data platform. This is a hands-on role focused on report development, model expansion, and the ongoing reliability of a production analytics stack that already drives company-wide reporting.

You will work closely with stakeholders across the business, including operations, finance, dispatch, inventory, vendor management, and others. You need to be an expert at building and maintaining these relationships. They will help give you the context and information needed to deliver reporting and insights that enhances how the business runs.

Our source systems are varied and disparate, with multiple ERPs, each carrying its own schema, conventions, and quirks. A core part of the job is reconciling those differences and producing a sanitized & harmonized view where the business can compare like-for-like across entities and source systems. If you enjoy untangling messy data and turning it into something trustworthy, then this is the place for you.

What You Will Do:

  • Develop, maintain, and extend Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and alerting across finance, operations, inventory, dispatch, and vendor management
  • Write and optimize complex SQL against Snowflake to investigate data, build models, and answer business questions
  • Build and refactor dbt models that standardize and harmonize data extracted from multiple ERPs into a unified, comparable schema
  • Setup the data in scalable and consumable way to enable the organization to be most well suited humans and agents
  • Reconcile disparate source-system definitions (chart of accounts, item masters, customer and vendor records, transaction types) so the business sees a true apples-to-apples view
  • Partner with stakeholders across the business to elicit requirements, understand operational context, and translate business questions into reliable reporting
  • Proactively surface findings, anomalies, and improvement opportunities discovered in the data
  • Monitor Fivetran connectors, dbt runs, and Power BI refreshes; triage and resolve data quality and pipeline issues
  • Respond to ad-hoc data requests that drive business decisions and initiatives
  • Document data models, definitions, and report logic so knowledge is shared, not siloed

Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of professional experience as a data analyst, analytics engineer, or BI developer
  • Extremely strong SQL skills, including comfort with CTEs, window functions, indexing, stored procedures, performance tuning, and debugging complex joins across large datasets.
  • Understanding of relational databases and scalable design.
  • Extremely strong Power BI skills, including:

jobs.description:
Description

Agile Space Industries is a rapidly growing supplier of propulsion hardware and engineering services for the space industry. Headquartered in Durango, Colorado, with expanding operations in and Tulsa, Oklahoma, and upcoming growth in Seattle, Washington, Agile has achieved more than 40% year-over-year growth for the past three years, and our momentum continues to accelerate.

At Agile, we design, build, and test in-space propulsion systems that give spacecraft the ability to maneuver with precision, reliability, and purpose. Our technologies play a critical role in missions that range from lunar landings and resource utilization to national defense, human exploration, and commercial space transport.

We are seeking bold and driven individuals who thrive in a hands-on, fast-moving environment and want to help write the next chapter of space history as part of a close-knit, innovative team. You will take on a demanding and rewarding role at Agile, directly shaping the future of in-space propulsion. As an integral contributor during our growth stage, you will be eligible to participate in our stock option plan, giving you the opportunity to share in the long-term value you help create. All stock grants are subject to executive review and approval in accordance with the Company’s equity plan.

Agile Space Industries is seeking an experienced onsite Data Acquisition and Controls Systems (DACS) LabVIEW Engineer in Tulsa, OK to provide technical experience and depth to our DACS team supporting hypergolic propulsion systems testing. The ideal candidate for this role will have technical experience to provide guidance to other DACS engineers and program teams, to make informed architecture decisions, and guide the development process while working as a team member on active development projects. Critical skillsets include systems design and development, LabVIEW development, project and team leadership skills, and technical decision making with a focus on safety and reliability. This position requires a leadership and collaboration mindset with a focus on pragmatic and timely implementation.

This position is onsite and may be based in either Tulsa, Oklahoma or Durango, Colorado.

Responsibilities
• Support the Agile Test Site Operations team by designing, developing, testing, integrating, troubleshooting, and upgrading software used in propulsion testing
• Work in NI LabVIEW, including LabVIEW FPGA and LabVIEW Real-Time, to create and maintain control and measurement applications
• Work with sensors including but not limited to pressure transducers, thermocouples, RTDs, strain gauges, accelerometers, pyrometers, and flow meters
• Work with control mechanisms including but not limited to pneumatic solenoid valves, remote pressure regulators, relays, valve drivers, VFDs, motorized throttling valves
• Ensure compliance with applicable software development standards and best practices
• Interface with various test and measurement instruments such as power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes
• Implement and support communication protocols including VISA, TCP/IP, and serial interfaces
• All work shall be performed in a collaborative team environment with a focus on safety and long-term system reliability

• You will be required to work on-site at our testing facilities located in Durango, CO

• 8+ Years relevant experience
• 5+ Years experience with LabVIEW (Actor Framework preferred)
• Demonstrated expertise in programming languages such as Python or C++
• Demonstrated expertise in the fundamentals of object-oriented programming
• Hands-on experience designing and debugging low voltage electrical systems
• Experience working within Linux-based environments
